questions.stemEn: A 5-year-old child has fever and upper respiratory symptoms for two days, then develops eye pain and periorbital redness. Eye movements are preserved. What should you do next?
questions.explanationAr: Periorbital erythema مع preserved extraocular movements تميل إلى preseptal cellulitis أكثر من orbital cellulitis. لذلك مفتاح المصدر هو بدء antibiotics، مع تقييم أي red flags للـorbital involvement.
questions.reasoningEn: Preserved ocular motility and a recent upper respiratory illness support preseptal cellulitis in the source vignette.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: CT يصبح أهم عند الاشتباه بـorbital cellulitis أو complications. Ophthalmology referral يعتمد على شدة الحالة ووجود orbital signs. Urine dipstick غير مرتبط بالمشكلة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Pain with eye movement, ophthalmoplegia, proptosis or visual impairment are red flags for orbital cellulitis.

questions.stemEn: A child presents with bilateral red eyes. The cornea is clear and there is crusted yellowish discharge. What is the treatment?
questions.explanationAr: Purulent yellow discharge مع eyelids stuck/crusted يدعم bacterial conjunctivitis. المصدر يختار topical antibiotics، لكنه يذكر أيضًا أن كثيرًا من الحالات self-limited؛ لذلك نحتاج تحديثًا قبل اعتماد السياسة العلاجية النهائية.
questions.reasoningEn: Purulent discharge is more typical of bacterial conjunctivitis than viral or allergic conjunctivitis.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Lubricants أو reassurance قد تكون كافية في بعض حالات viral conjunctivitis، بينما ophthalmology referral يُحجز عادةً للـred flags أو التشخيص غير الواضح.
questions.clinicalPearl: Corneal pain, photophobia, reduced vision, contact-lens use or severe unilateral disease warrant more urgent eye evaluation.

tts.text: A child presents with bilateral red eyes. The cornea is clear and there is crusted yellowish discharge. What is the treatment? A. Topical lubricant. B. Topical antibiotics. C. Refer to ophthalmologist. D. Reassurance.

sourceRefs.sourceName: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection 4th Ed 2026

verification.referenceNotes: Treatment recommendation should be freshness-checked because uncomplicated bacterial conjunctivitis may be self-limited.

questions.stemEn: During an infant well-child visit, oral thrush is noted. The liver is palpable 1 cm below the costal margin and the spleen tip is palpable. How should this infant be managed?
questions.explanationAr: في infant سليم، liver 1 cm تحت costal margin وpalpable spleen tip قد يكونان ضمن الطبيعي. المشكلة الفعلية هي oral candidiasis، ومفتاح المصدر topical nystatin.
questions.reasoningEn: The abdominal examination described can be normal in an infant; the actionable finding is oral candidiasis.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: وجود هذه العلامات وحدها لا يفرض CBC أو HIV testing دون clues إضافية لimmunodeficiency. Reassurance وحدها لا تعالج thrush.
questions.clinicalPearl: Persistent, recurrent or unusually severe thrush can become a clue to immunodeficiency, but a single typical episode is common in infants.

questions.stemEn: A diaper rash with satellite lesions involving the skin folds is shown. What is the treatment?
questions.explanationAr: Satellite papules/pustules مع involvement of skin folds هي clues كلاسيكية لـCandida diaper dermatitis؛ لذلك المصدر يختار topical nystatin.
questions.reasoningEn: Candida diaper dermatitis characteristically involves folds and has satellite lesions.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Zinc oxide يفيد irritant diaper dermatitis لكنه لا يعالج Candida. Antibiotic غير مناسب دون bacterial infection. Steroid وحده قد يزيد fungal disease سوءًا.
questions.clinicalPearl: Irritant diaper dermatitis tends to spare the folds; candidal dermatitis often involves them.

questions.stemEn: A baby has perianal redness and itching without a nocturnal pattern. His older brother, who bathes with him, has similar symptoms. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: غياب nocturnal predominance يقلل احتمال pinworm. Perianal streptococcal dermatitis يعطي well-demarcated bright erythema مع itching/burning وقد يرتبط بعدوى streptococcal عند أفراد الأسرة.
questions.reasoningEn: Perianal GAS dermatitis fits the bright localized erythema and lack of a predominantly nocturnal itch pattern.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Enterobius classically causes perianal itching that is worse at night.
questions.clinicalPearl: Bright, sharply demarcated perianal erythema in a child should prompt consideration of GAS dermatitis.

image.captionEn: Original source image shows the perianal rash pattern.

questions.stemEn: A child has several months of abdominal pain and distension. Abdominal CT shows multiple cysts in the liver consistent with hydatid disease. What is the treatment?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار albendazole لعلاج echinococcal hydatid disease. لكن management قد يعتمد على حجم وعدد وموقع cysts وقد يحتاج تدخلًا جراحيًا أو percutaneous approach، لذلك نحتفظ بالمفتاح ونطلب تحققًا قبل النشر النهائي.
questions.reasoningEn: Albendazole is an antihelminthic used in echinococcosis; definitive management may depend on cyst characteristics.
questions.clinicalPearl: Do not assume medical therapy alone is sufficient for every hepatic hydatid cyst; morphology and complications matter.

questions.stemEn: A child recently arrived from Sudan with fever and is diagnosed with malaria. How should he be treated?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر نفسه يضع علامة استفهام على الإجابة ويؤكد أن artemisinin monotherapy غير موصى بها. العلاج يعتمد على species، severity، resistance pattern ومكان اكتساب العدوى. لذلك هذا السؤال لا يجوز نشره بإجابة A كإجابة مؤكدة.
questions.reasoningEn: The recalled option is not sufficiently specified and the source itself warns that monotherapy is inappropriate; malaria therapy must be species- and severity-specific.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Mefloquine وproguanil لا يمكن اختيارهما بشكل صحيح دون معرفة species/severity والسياق العلاجي أو الوقائي.
questions.clinicalPearl: A malaria treatment question is incomplete without severity/species and current regional resistance context.

tts.text: A child recently arrived from Sudan with fever and is diagnosed with malaria. How should he be treated? A. Arterolane or artemether. B. Mefloquine. C. Proguanil.
